title: Web UI header slimming & dedicated Resume Required section
summary: Compact sticky header (in-progress only) + dedicated Resume Required section before the work tree.
description:
Redesign the planner Web UI sticky header so it stays compact and offloads resume-required tasks to a dedicated, scannable section.

Files touched (packages/plan-web-ui):
- src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx — `TaskFocusHeader` now renders ONLY `focus.active` (the `pendingResume` section was removed); `FocusTaskRow` exported for reuse. Header height complaint resolved: header shows in-progress tasks only.
- src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — single-row TopNav (done earlier): smaller buttons (h-8/h-9, text-xs/sm:text-sm), mobile hamburger (lucide Menu/X + click-outside + Escape) holding nav + Export; theme toggle + live badge always visible; Dashboard link dropped (logo already links to '/'); project path kept only as a brand title tooltip.
- src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx — filter bar (done earlier): 6 ToolbarButton toggles collapsed from a 3-row grid into a single horizontally scrollable flex row with a visible desktop scrollbar (scrollbar hidden only on mobile), smaller buttons.
- src/components/dashboard/resume-required.tsx — NEW `ResumeRequiredSection` lists `taskFocus.pendingResume` (title + entity-path badges + status + 'Resume required' pill + Locate) with NO checkpoint reason/description; placed BEFORE `<WorkTree/>` on the dashboard route.
- src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx — consumes `taskFocus` from `useRouteLoaderData("root")` and renders `<ResumeRequiredSection tasks={taskFocus.pendingResume} />` before `<WorkTree/>`.
- test/entity-references-and-updates.test.tsx — updated the two resume-marker tests to render `ResumeRequiredSection` instead of `TaskFocusHeader` with `pendingResume`.

Current state: header compaction (single-row TopNav, single-row filters, in-progress-only header) and the Resume Required section are CODE-COMPLETE and typecheck-clean (tsc --noEmit passes) with the entity-references tests passing 6/6. NOT yet rebuilt/copied into the served web-ui-dist bundle, and NOT committed (project rule: stay on feature branch, no commit without explicit request).

Behaviors to preserve: in-progress tasks remain in the sticky header with Locate + entity-path links; the full checkpoint (Why paused / Work checkpoint / Resume from / How to resume) stays ONLY in the task detail view (src/components/task/resume-snapshot.tsx, rendered by routes/task-detail/route.tsx) — never in the header or the resume section.

Build/deploy note: a single `pnpm build` (root) now runs tsc -b + pnpm build:web-ui + bash scripts/copy-web-ui.sh, which deploys the bundle to ALL packages/*/web-ui-dist consumers (pi-adapter, plan-server). The live pi dashboard on :56321 serves a baked-in stale bundle (B97B4wii) and will only reflect edits after a rebuild+copy AND a process restart; verify against a freshly built plan-server on a clean port with cache-busting.

tasks.title: Slim sticky header to in-progress only; relocate resume-required tasks to a dedicated section before the work tree
tasks.description:
Implement a compact planner Web UI layout: the sticky header shows ONLY in-progress (active) tasks, and resume-required (paused/pendingResume) tasks move to a dedicated, scannable section placed before the work tree on the dashboard — listed WITHOUT the checkpoint reason/description.

Code references (packages/plan-web-ui):
- src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx — `TaskFocusHeader` now renders only `focus.active` (pendingResume section removed); `FocusTaskRow` is exported for reuse.
- src/components/dashboard/resume-required.tsx — NEW `ResumeRequiredSection({ tasks })` renders `taskFocus.pendingResume` via `FocusTaskRow`: entity-path badges (F/P/T + shortId), StatusBadge, 'Resume required' pill, title link to task detail, Locate button. No checkpoint reason/description.
- src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx — pulls `taskFocus` from `useRouteLoaderData("root")` (root loader returns `{project, uiConfig, taskFocus}`) and renders `<ResumeRequiredSection tasks={taskFocus.pendingResume} />` immediately BEFORE `<WorkTree/>`.
- (Earlier, same effort) src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx single-row redesign + src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx single-row filter bar.

Current state: CODE-COMPLETE. `pnpm check` (tsc --noEmit) passes clean; `pnpm vitest run test/entity-references-and-updates.test.tsx` passes 6/6 (the two resume-marker tests were updated to render `ResumeRequiredSection`).

Edge cases / behaviors to preserve:
- When there are zero active tasks, `TaskFocusHeader` returns null (header hidden) — resume tasks still show in the dashboard section.
- The full checkpoint (Why paused / Work checkpoint / Resume from / How to resume) remains ONLY in the task detail view (src/components/task/resume-snapshot.tsx via routes/task-detail/route.tsx) — never in the header or the resume section.
- `ActiveTasksHeader` wrapper still passes `pendingResume: []` and is unaffected.

Verification steps remaining (NOT yet done):
1. Rebuild + copy: `pnpm build` at repo root (runs tsc -b + build:web-ui + scripts/copy-web-ui.sh to all packages/*/web-ui-dist).
2. Verify on a CLEAN port with a freshly started plan-server serving agent-plan's .planner (the user's :3030 pi serves a DIFFERENT project — HypePublicSiteMonorepo — so it must not be used for agent-plan verification), with browser cache-busting, confirming: header shows only in-progress; 'Resume required (n)' section appears before the work tree; rows have no reason/description.
3. No commit (project rule: stay on feature branch, commit only on explicit request).

Note: the live pi dashboard on :56321 serves a baked-in stale bundle (B97B4wii) and needs a full rebuild+copy+restart to reflect edits.

tasks.notes: Deviation corrected (2026-08-21): the initial T302 implementation changed FocusTaskRow's title from the release's inline `flex-1 truncate` (single row) to `block` with `truncate` REMOVED, and bumped font to `sm:text-base`. That style change was made WITHOUT user agreement and introduced a title-wrapping regression ("titles go to second row"). User corrected: UI style/layout changes must be proposed and agreed, not done unilaterally (especially deviations from the released behavior). Fix: reverted title to `flex-1 truncate` inline single-row (matches release), removed `sm:text-base`. Confirmed by user ("1. si"). Also: scripts/dev-web.mjs now (a) polls /api/health before starting Vite (removes the backend-not-ready WS race) and (b) spawns Vite directly (no pnpm wrapper) + detached children, so Ctrl-C shuts down cleanly without ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL. Note: a benign vite-proxy WS ECONNRESET may still appear once at startup (proxied live-sync socket resets then reconnects; one connection stays up).

tasks.title: Add resume-required icon to WorkTree task rows
tasks.description:
Add a per-task "resume required" icon (with tooltip) in the Work Tree so paused-and-switched-away tasks are visually identifiable in their phase, not only in the dedicated "Resume required" section or the header.

Data source: the root loader already returns `taskFocus.pendingResume` (the resume-required tasks, derived from `workDeviations` with state `resume-required` in packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts / plan-store.ts). Build a `Set<taskId>` from it and thread it down:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx (DashboardRoute, reads taskFocus via useRouteLoaderData("root")) → pass to <WorkTree/>.
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx (WorkTree + FeatureTreeRow call site) → pass to FeatureTreeRow.
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx (FeatureTreeRow → PhaseTreeRow → TaskTreeRow) → pass to TaskTreeRow.

Rendering (TaskTreeRow): when `resumeRequiredIds.has(task.id)`, render an inline `RotateCcw` icon (lucide-react, same glyph used in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/task/resume-snapshot.tsx for pendingResume) in the badge row next to ShortIdBadge / in-progress dot, with a native `title` tooltip ("Resume required — this task was paused and must be resumed before starting new work.") and aria-label. Visible on mobile + desktop. Accent/warning tone, non-invasive.

Verification: `pnpm check` (web-ui tsc --noEmit) clean; run `pnpm dev` (localhost:5175) and confirm the resume-required task (e.g. T299/MA23W) shows the RotateCcw icon in its phase row with tooltip, while non-resume tasks do not. No commit (project rule: stay on feature branch).

---
**Completion summary:**
IMPLEMENTED + typecheck-clean (pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui check → 0 errors).

Added a per-task "resume required" icon in the Work Tree so paused-and-switched-away tasks are identifiable in their phase, not only in the dedicated "Resume required" section or the header.

What changed (packages/plan-web-ui):
- routes/dashboard/route.tsx: build `resumeRequiredIds = useMemo(() => new Set((taskFocus.pendingResume ?? []).map(t => t.id)), [taskFocus.pendingResume])` from the root loader's `taskFocus.pendingResume`, and pass it to <WorkTree/>.
- components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx: WorkTree accepts `resumeRequiredIds?: Set<string>` (defaulted to empty Set in destructuring) and forwards it to FeatureTreeRow.
- components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx: threaded `resumeRequiredIds` through FeatureTreeRow → PhaseTreeRow → TaskTreeRow (each defaulted to new Set<string>() to satisfy exactOptionalPropertyTypes). TaskTreeRow renders an inline `RotateCcw` lucide icon (same glyph as resume-snapshot.tsx for pendingResume) in the badge row when `resumeRequiredIds.has(task.id)`, with a native `title` tooltip ("Resume required — this task was paused and must be resumed before starting new work.") + aria-label, accent color, visible on mobile + desktop.

Data source: taskFocus.pendingResume (root loader) = resume-required tasks derived from workDeviations state "resume-required" (plan-core task-selection.ts / plan-store.ts). No new API; pure presentation.

Verification: web-ui tsc --noEmit clean. Dev server was killed at the user's request so they can run `pnpm dev` (localhost:5175) and see the RotateCcw icon on the resume-required task (T299 / MA23W) inside its phase row, while non-resume tasks show none.

Planner: T303 started via task_switch from T299 (P069/F005) — completing T303 will re-emit RESUME REQUIRED for T299. No commit (project rule: stay on feature branch).
